domain.docs: The domain to list routes for.

phone.docs: The phone number to list routes for.

__package__.yml.rawContents:
service:
  auth: false
  base-path: ''
  endpoints:
    ListInboundRoutes:
      path: /inbound/routes
      method: POST
      source:
        openapi: ../openapi.yml
      request:
        name: InboundRoutesRequest
        body:
          properties:
            domain:
              type: optional<string>
              docs: The domain to list routes for.
            phone:
              type: optional<string>
              docs: The phone number to list routes for.
          extends:
            - ApiKey
        content-type: application/json
      examples:
        - request:
            key: key
    AddInboundRoute:
      path: /inbound/add-route
      method: POST
      source:
        openapi: ../openapi.yml
      request:
        name: InboundAddRouteRequest
        body:
          properties:
            domain: optional<string>
            phone: optional<string>
            pattern: optional<string>
            url:
              type: string
              validation:
                format: uri
          extends:
            - ApiKey
        content-type: application/json
      examples:
        - request:
            key: key
            url: url
    PostShapes:
      path: /shapes
      method: POST
      source:
        openapi: ../openapi.yml
      request:
        name: PostShapesRequest
        body:
          properties:
            contact: optional<Contact>
            narrowsProperty: optional<OneOfBranchNarrowsProperty>
            addsProperty: optional<OneOfBranchAddsProperty>
            singleBranch: optional<OneOfSingleBranch>
            withNot: optional<OneOfBranchWithNot>
        content-type: application/json
      examples:
        - request: {}
  source:
    openapi: ../openapi.yml
types:
  ApiKey:
    properties:
      key: string
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
  Contact:
    properties:
      email: optional<string>
      phone: optional<string>
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
  OneOfBranchNarrowsPropertyZeroKind:
    enum:
      - a
    inline: true
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
  OneOfBranchNarrowsPropertyZero:
    properties:
      kind: OneOfBranchNarrowsPropertyZeroKind
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
    inline: true
  OneOfBranchNarrowsPropertyOneKind:
    enum:
      - b
    inline: true
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
  OneOfBranchNarrowsPropertyOne:
    properties:
      kind: OneOfBranchNarrowsPropertyOneKind
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
    inline: true
  OneOfBranchNarrowsProperty:
    discriminated: false
    base-properties:
      kind: optional<string>
      value: optional<string>
    union:
      - OneOfBranchNarrowsPropertyZero
      - OneOfBranchNarrowsPropertyOne
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
  OneOfBranchAddsPropertyB:
    properties:
      b: boolean
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
    inline: true
  OneOfBranchAddsProperty:
    discriminated: false
    base-properties:
      a: optional<boolean>
    union:
      - unknown
      - OneOfBranchAddsPropertyB
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
  OneOfSingleBranch:
    properties:
      a: string
      b: optional<string>
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
  OneOfBranchWithNot:
    discriminated: false
    base-properties:
      a: optional<string>
      b: optional<string>
    union:
      - unknown
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
